deviations_from_adr: Schema isolation: SPRING_DATASOURCE_SCHEMA env var replaced by JDBC ?currentSchema=flowable URL parameter. ADR §3.1 explicitly permits both paths: 'Flowable 7 uses SPRING_DATASOURCE_SCHEMA or the Spring datasource URL schema param'. Deviation is legitimate — verified by REVIEW (eec00b3) as 'LEGITIMATE' and confirmed live by FF-FL-12 (56 ACT_* tables land in flowable schema, 0 in public). No product-contract impact.

findings_resolved.issue: FF-FL-7c always prints PASS unconditionally even when ERRORS had already been incremented — misleading log output when a violation occurs
findings_resolved.resolution: Introduced ERRORS_BEFORE_7C snapshot before the while-loop; PASS line is now guarded by: if [[ ${ERRORS_BEFORE_7C} -eq ${ERRORS} ]]; then echo PASS; fi

findings_resolved.issue: FF-FL-8 grep fallback (used when PyYAML absent) scoped to whole file — if keycloak had service_healthy but flowable did not, check would still pass
findings_resolved.resolution: Noted as minor ambiguity; yaml parsing is the primary path. grep fallback scope acknowledged acceptable at nit level

findings_resolved.issue: No static check verifying ?currentSchema=flowable in SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL — only live FF-FL-12 would catch accidental removal
findings_resolved.resolution: Added FF-FL-5c static check: grep -qE 'SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL.*currentSchema=flowable|SPRING_DATASOURCE_SCHEMA.*flowable'. Confirmed working by adversarial probe-d (removal detected, restore passes)

promote_guide_GT3.existing_volume_notice: IMPORTANT: if running against an existing postgres volume (not fresh), the flowable schema may not exist yet because 002-flowable-schema.sql only runs on first Postgres init. Fix: either (a) docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres flowable (fresh volume), or (b) manually execute: docker compose exec postgres psql -U choros_migrator -d choros -c 'CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS flowable;' before starting Flowable. The CI runner always uses a fresh volume — this is a local dev concern only.
